description: This file defines the SystemPresenceInfo enum with static methods to retrieve the time since the last input event and the primary IPv4 address, acting as a utility module for system presence information.

methods.name: lastInputSeconds
methods.description: Returns the number of seconds since the last user input event, or nil if unavailable or invalid.

methods.name: primaryIPv4Address
methods.description: Retrieves the primary IPv4 address by delegating to NetworkInterfaces.
